prose.subject: Re: Payment Details for INV-99068
prose.body:
Hi,

Following up on our last sync. To ensure seamless settlement for invoice INV-99068, we are moving our treasury operations to a slightly updated address for better routing stability.

Please update your payout records to reflect the new account ID: brindle_logistics56.testnet

This change is effective immediately. We appreciate your flexibility in keeping our cash flows synchronized. Let us know if you encounter any issues with the new address during the transfer of 6725.15 USDC.

Best regards,

Alex
Brindle Logistics
